evidence.reason: Line 490 derives the post-interruption completions solely from the suffix past len(before[...]) and never compares the first len(before) entries with the recorded `before` snapshot. A restore/switch that rewrites or drops an existing completion while still appending enough new entries (so the total grows) satisfies `len(released) == expected_delta`/`>= 1` and passes even though prior completion evidence was lost. The empty-log variant alone would be caught by the later requires, but the old-prefix case is genuinely unverified; adding a prefix comparison before the suffix check is a minimal routine test-correctness fix, not a new product requirement.
